description: Search GitHub repositories and Hugging Face models, demos and datasets together, by what the person wants to do. Returns ranked results with license, popularity, last update, where each value was read, and whether the maintainer declared support for the given operating system. 'fit' is 'declared' or 'unknown'; it is never a guess.

kind.description: Limit to one type. Default: all.

os.description: The person's operating system, to put declared matches first.

query.description: What the person wants to build or run, in plain words. A few keywords work best.

name: search
title: Search projects, models and demos
